claims.rule: CTRL_REG4 address23 is RW. ST occupies bits2:1 and default00; legal code storage/readback may be tested while maintaining legal neighboring mode/interface settings. UNSPEC is an old audit exclusion label, not the manufacturer access type.
ST00 disabled, ST01 self-test0, ST10 self-test1. ST11 row is --, not an ordinary legal RW persistence test. Rejecting it at an adapter boundary does not assert silicon ignores or resets that code.

STATUS address27 is read-only Output in the summary, but Table47 explicitly gives zero defaults for ZYXOR7 ZOR6 YOR5 XOR4 ZYXDA3 ZDA2 YDA1. Known default maskFE, expected0, only at initial settled boot/default boundary before qualified sample events. Bit0 XDA has no description/default in Table47 and is not part of known reset mask.

Self-test produces electrostatic acceleration and a physical output difference; the source settling requirement is two samples low-power/normal or eight high-resolution. Legal ST storage is not completion, analog response, sign/amplitude or timing certification. Qualified output sample events with ST nonzero need not be modeled by this bounded task.

YDA/ZDA indicate new data available for their axes, ZYXDA indicates a new set available. Qualified simultaneous XYZ completion in bypass/no-read/no-history-change scope may establish these known bits1. XDA is excluded because its row is absent. No arbitrary partial-axis aggregation oracle follows.

Per-axis overrun indicates newly generated data overwrote previous axis data; ZYXOR indicates a new set overwrote previous set. Two qualified simultaneous XYZ completed samples with BDU0 and no intervening output/status reads support overwrite witness at FE mask. BDU-blocked nonwrites must not be called output overwrites; exact post-read flag history not specified.

Acceleration outputs are signed two-complement left-justified. Qualified integer codes use8/10/12 significant bits for low-power/normal/high-resolution respectively. BLE0 lower-addressLSB, BLE1 lower-addressMSB; BLE can activate only high-resolution. Source format clauses are supporting scope, not eight new repaired output fields, not mg-to-code calibration.

BDU0 continuous update; BDU1 output registers not updated until MSB and LSB reading. This proves hold-until-both-read boundary, not precise pending/latest/next sample release, per-axis versus whole-XYZ granularity, duplicate-half read policy or post-release STATUS clear behavior.

Legal LPen/HR pairs are10 low-power,00 normal,01 high-resolution;11 not allowed. ODR0 power-down,1-7 allthree modes,8 low-power only,9 high-resolution/normal1.344kHz or low-power5.376kHz;10-15 undefined. Settled qualified logical sample events do not execute wall-clock turn-on/ODR scheduling or active-history mode transition.

Register/event adapter only. Use quiescent legal configuration, allaxes enabled, FIFO off/bypass, filter bypass, ST0 for qualified sample scenarios. No actual I2C ACK/frame/SPI/electrical/physical acceleration/self-test/clock certification; out-of-scope errors constrain benchmark input only.

Reviewed Rev2 STATUS descriptions do not specify how STATUS or any output-byte/pair read clears or preserves DA/OR bits. Explicit INT1/INT2 source-register readclear provisions belong to other registers and cannot be transferred to STATUS. No common-source post-read reset/retention oracle after first observed read.

ZYXDA and ZYXOR prose refers to XYZ/new set without explicit OR/AND truth table for independently updated/read/disabled axes. Simultaneous allaxis no-read cases have common outcome; partial or mixed-history cases must be excluded or labelled hypothesis.
